description: Creates or updates customers' store credit, matched by ItemId, then by customer and currency.

items.description: A customer's store credit in one currency.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

CustomerId.description: The id of the customer who holds the credit. Import the customers first.

Currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the credit.

Activity.description: The changes to the balance, oldest first.

Accounts.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
